description: Turn an audio recording into text via Whisper. Give it EITHER 'url' (fetched server-side — a pre-signed link works, no auth is sent) OR 'base64'. Use it for voicemail from the phone system, call recordings and voice notes: those arrive as sound, and guessing what was said is not an option. Optional 'language' (ISO-639-1 like 'de') skips auto-detection and is more reliable on short clips; optional 'prompt' is a few words of context that stop Whisper from mangling proper nouns (company names, people). Returns the transcript plus duration and detected language. Limit is 25 MB per file — split longer recordings. Whisper is OpenAI-only: a tenant on Ollama falls back to the environment key.

base64.description: The audio itself, base64. A data: prefix is stripped.

filename.description: Name with extension, e.g. 'voicemail.mp3'. Whisper derives the format from it — without one it guesses.

prompt.description: Context words for names and jargon.

url.description: Address of the audio file. Fetched by the server; pre-signed links are fine.

name: transcribe_audio
